name: mealdeal
description: Grocery price aggregation and comparison across Dutch supermarket chains

scripts.db:up: docker start mealdeal-pg || docker run -d --name mealdeal-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=mealdeal -e POSTGRES_USER=mealdeal -e POSTGRES_DB=mealdeal -p 5433:5432 postgres:17-alpine
scripts.db:migrate: node -e "const {connect,migrate}=await import('./src/ingest/db.ts');const db=connect();await migrate(db);await db.end();console.log('schema applied')" --input-type=module
